issues.advice: Make the verb structure simpler: try 'walking while playing on her mobile phone' or 'walking and playing on her mobile phone.'
Use the clearer verb form 'it broke' (active) or change to 'her phone was broken' if you want passive. 'It broke' is more direct here.
